result.card: PR 36264 fixes stale argument names and inaccurate examples in wallet RPCs (listtransactions, listsinceblock, and sendmany). It fixes the 'Negative from' error to reference 'skip', names the failing parameter in listsinceblock, and stops sendmany examples from pretending the dummy minconf argument sets confirmations. The problem affects RPC callers troubleshooting invalid requests, though it has no impact on fund safety or wallet behavior. Review state is positive and ready after the author split the commits and dropped edits to deprecated arguments per review.
